raw.verdict: A and C both grounded every number in the recorded overview. A went further: it named the peak and trough, flagged the Feb-2026 positive-tone anomaly, attached URLs to the critical headlines, and caught the feed's false positives and label duplications. C is clean but thinner on the critical stories. B and D honestly declined to measure, which leaves a decision-maker with nothing usable beyond a plan of calls.
